design_philosophy: Objective, rigid, function-first. High-density, scan-optimized modular boards. UI relies on grayscale structural dominance, allowing functional colors (Green/Amber/Red) to act as pure signal for the sales pipeline and performance metrics.

kanban_board.structure: Modular, scan-first horizontal scrolling container with fixed-width columns (w-80 or w-96).
kanban_board.column_header: Solid border-b border-border/40, uppercase overline typography, dynamic count badge.
kanban_board.card: Draggable. bg-card, 1px solid border-border, no drop shadow. modified F-pattern layout. Left border strip indicates pipeline stage color.
kanban_board.card_content: Deal name (Chivo, bold) at top. Metric/Value (JetBrains Mono) on right. Status/Date pill at bottom.

dashboard_stats.visuals: Cardless or 1px border. High-contrast typography. Use JetBrains Mono for all KPIs. Color-coded delta arrows (Green/Red).

sidebar.style: Strict, clean. border-r border-border/40. Monochromatic active states (bg-muted) instead of heavy color washes. Role-aware sections.

data_tables.style: Dense, grid-lines visible (border-b on rows, optional border-r for column definition). tabular-nums for numerical columns.

modal_forms.style: Right-side slide-over sheet (Shadcn Sheet) preferred for data entry (Visit Log, Follow-up, Product CRUD) to maintain context without losing dashboard view.

charts.styling: No background grids. Monochromatic or two-tone bars. Minimal tooltips.

icons.instructions: Use 'regular' weight for UI, 'fill' for active states.

image_urls.description: Abstract dark architectural lines background for Login screen

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Apply 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='kanban-drag-card', data-testid='sidebar-nav-item', data-testid='login-submit-button').
CRITICAL: Build using pure HTML+Tailwind for layout shells, heavily modifying Shadcn UI for interactive components. Avoid generic Vercel look.

Kanban Implementation: Use a horizontal scrolling flex container. Use standard HTML Drag and Drop API or a lightweight library (e.g., dnd-kit). Ensure columns have 'min-h-[500px]' so empty states still accept drops.
Typography Enforcement: Apply 'font-sans' (IBM Plex Sans) globally, use 'font-heading' (Chivo) for all h1-h4, and 'font-mono' (JetBrains Mono) for ALL numerical data points and KPIs.

Color Constraints: Never use colored text on colored backgrounds unless using the specific functional colors. Default to grayscale UI with functional color accents. DO NOT use teal or purple anywhere.
Mocked Integrations: Explicitly MOCK SpringEdge SMS/WhatsApp integrations using Sonner Toasts that say 'MOCKED SMS Sent to [Number]'. Use jsPDF and SheetJS for exporting features.
Mobile Responsive: The Visit Log Form, Dashboard, and Pipelines MUST degrade elegantly to a single column mobile view for field salespeople. Sidebar must convert to a hamburger/Sheet on mobile.
Map View: Implement a mocked or basic Leaflet map for the 'live agent map' feature on the CEO dashboard.
Notifications: Use 'sonner' library for all in-app toasts.
